name: l3a0
description: l3a0's personal Claude Code plugin marketplace. Skills for extracting Kindle highlights, for convening a board of advisor agents on a strategic decision or an engineering team on a code or post review, for keeping a repository's build board true, for turning a book PDF into page-numbered text, for pricing an agent loop from its transcripts, and for turning a book into page-checked rules for a team and its repositories.

plugins.name: l3a0
plugins.description: l3a0's Claude Code skills: kindle-highlights (verbatim Kindle highlight extraction with truncation recovery), ask-board (a board of ten advisor agents and a secretary for a sole operator's strategic decisions), ask-team (eight engineering role agents that review blind, with verifiers that refute by executing), update-build-board and sync-prune-next (a repository's GitHub build board and its status round), book-text (a book PDF to page-numbered text and reading parts, by pdftotext or Vision OCR, with a citation checker), loop-cost (a loop's cost in tokens and dollars from its agents' transcripts), and book-to-rules (a book read part by part into page-checked rules for a team, its plugin agents and a repository template).
